checks.title: Docker daemon service is active
checks.rationale: Inventory check that the Docker daemon is running and managed by systemd.
checks.remediation: systemctl enable --now docker.

checks.title: Docker daemon configured with live-restore
checks.rationale: Live-restore keeps running containers up when the daemon restarts.
checks.remediation: Add '"live-restore": true' to /etc/docker/daemon.json and restart docker.

checks.title: Default ulimits and storage driver verified
checks.rationale: overlay2 is the modern, supported storage driver. Avoid devicemapper-loopback.
checks.remediation: Set '"storage-driver": "overlay2"' in /etc/docker/daemon.json.

checks.title: Docker socket is owned by root:docker with mode 660 or stricter
checks.rationale: Anyone with write access to the socket can take over the host.
checks.remediation: chown root:docker /var/run/docker.sock && chmod 660 /var/run/docker.sock.

checks.title: No containers are running in privileged mode
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{.Name}} {{.HostConfig.Privileged}}' | awk '$2=="true" {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: Privileged containers can escape to the host. Use specific capabilities instead.
checks.remediation: Re-run containers without --privileged; drop to specific --cap-add as needed.

checks.title: No containers running as UID 0 (root) unless explicitly required
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{.Config.User}}' | awk '$0=="" || $0=="0" {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: Root inside the container is one syscall from root on the host given a kernel vuln.
checks.remediation: Add 'USER 10001' to Dockerfiles or pass '--user 10001:10001' at run time.

checks.title: Containers use a non-default AppArmor or seccomp profile
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{.AppArmorProfile}}' | awk '$0=="" || $0=="unconfined" {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: AppArmor/seccomp confine the syscall surface available to the container.
checks.remediation: Run with --security-opt apparmor=docker-default and --security-opt seccomp=<profile.json>.

checks.title: Manual: review docker network drivers and host networking usage
checks.audit: Run 'docker network ls' and 'docker ps --format "{{.Names}} {{.Networks}}"'. Confirm production containers do not use --network host unless required.
checks.rationale: --network host bypasses Docker's network namespace isolation.
checks.remediation: Re-run with bridge networks; expose only required ports.

checks.title: Manual: confirm registry image signing / pull policy
checks.audit: Confirm DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1 is set for the daemon environment, or that an admission controller (e.g., Notary/Sigstore) enforces signed images.
checks.rationale: Image signing prevents pulling tampered or unauthorized images.
checks.remediation: Enable Docker Content Trust or deploy a Sigstore policy controller.

checks.title: Manual: review /var/lib/docker resides on a dedicated volume
checks.audit: Run 'findmnt /var/lib/docker'. Confirm it's a dedicated filesystem (not part of /).
checks.rationale: Container/image data on a separate volume prevents host disk exhaustion.
checks.remediation: Mount a dedicated volume at /var/lib/docker.

checks.title: Docker service is enabled at boot
checks.rationale: The daemon should start on boot so host protections are always present.
checks.remediation: systemctl enable docker.

checks.title: Docker Engine is a currently supported major version
checks.rationale: Out-of-support engines stop receiving CVE backports.
checks.remediation: Upgrade Docker Engine to a supported release.

checks.title: userland-proxy is disabled
checks.rationale: The userland proxy adds attack surface; the iptables NAT path is preferred.
checks.remediation: Set '"userland-proxy": false' in /etc/docker/daemon.json and restart docker.

checks.title: no-new-privileges is enabled by default
checks.rationale: Blocks privilege escalation via setuid binaries inside containers.
checks.remediation: Set '"no-new-privileges": true' in /etc/docker/daemon.json and restart docker.

checks.title: Inter-container communication (icc) is disabled on the default bridge
checks.rationale: Disabling icc forces explicit, least-privilege container networking.
checks.remediation: Set '"icc": false' in /etc/docker/daemon.json and use user-defined networks.

checks.title: A persistent logging driver is configured
checks.rationale: Container logs must be captured for incident response; 'none' loses them.
checks.remediation: Set '"log-driver"' (e.g., 'local' with size limits) in /etc/docker/daemon.json.

checks.title: docker.service unit file is owned by root:root
checks.rationale: Write access to the unit file allows tampering with daemon flags.
checks.remediation: chown root:root on the docker.service unit file.

checks.title: /etc/docker directory is root-owned and 755 or stricter
checks.rationale: Loose permissions on /etc/docker expose daemon and TLS configuration.
checks.remediation: chown root:root /etc/docker && chmod 755 /etc/docker.

checks.title: Running containers have a memory limit set
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.Memory}}' | awk '$1==0 {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: Without a memory limit a single container can OOM the whole host.
checks.remediation: Run containers with --memory (e.g., --memory 512m).

checks.title: Running containers have a PIDs limit set
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}}' | awk '$1==0 || $1==-1 {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: A PIDs limit contains fork-bomb style denial of service.
checks.remediation: Run containers with --pids-limit (e.g., --pids-limit 100).

checks.title: No running container mounts the Docker socket
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} {{end}}' | awk '/docker\.sock/ {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: A container with the Docker socket mounted has full control of the host.
checks.remediation: Remove '-v /var/run/docker.sock' bind mounts; use a scoped API proxy instead.

checks.title: Running containers define a HEALTHCHECK
checks.command: docker ps --quiet --filter status=running 2>/dev/null | xargs -r docker inspect --format '{{if .Config.Healthcheck}}ok{{else}}none{{end}}' | awk '/none/ {n++} END {print n+0}'
checks.rationale: Health checks let the orchestrator detect and replace unhealthy containers.
checks.remediation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction to images or --health-cmd at run time.
